title: Connecting Visual Evidence to Enterprise Memory
description: I am examining how the image pipeline could connect with enterprise content and graph-based retrieval. The question is architectural: how can visual records, controlled entities, captions, and document evidence remain connected without becoming one undifferentiated store?
